{{Top|leg}}
A '''robo-hauler''' was a simple vehicle [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and a cheaper alternative to [[Loader droid/Legends|freight droids]]. They consisted of a limited function [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] connected to an industrial vehicle, usually a cargo bed, engine and treads. The [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[BigHaul Robo-Hauler]] was one such model.
